request.description: Creates a question set and its first draft (version 1). `content`: `stage`, `scope` (`segments`, `subSegments`, `categories`, `leadSources`; empty means any), `sections`, and ordered `items` (`questionKey`, `required`, `section`, `visibleIf` condition over attributes). Drafts may contain problems; they are listed in the version's `issues` and block submission. Staff only. Question sets are versioned config: draft → submit (maker) → approve or reject (a different staff member, in Change Requests) → publish → retire. Reading needs config read access; making, publishing and retiring need config maker access for question sets (ops lead, super admin).
